subject: Cutover safety: quarter-mile smoke & rollback scenarios for EdgeBank private deployment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.company>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.company>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.company>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.company>, John Pritchard <johnp@edgebank.com>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@dcs.com>
Cc: ops@edgebank.com
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cutover safety: quarter-mile smoke & rollback scenarios for EdgeBank private deployment

Team / EdgeBank / DCS,

Purpose: align on the "quarter-mile" smoke (short, focused workload) and explicit rollback triggers for tomorrow's VPC-onprem cutover. This thread captures owners, acceptance criteria, attachments, and the bridge time.

High level plan (15–30 minute focused test window):
- Bridge open at 14:00 PST (14:00 - 14:30 target window).
- Quarter-mile smoke = 15 minutes of controlled traffic (read-heavy steady-state with low writes) to validate routing, KV cache priming, and telemetry.
- Observability: App traces, token-level cost sampling, per-route latency histograms, and Netflow samples recorded to the shared bucket.

Acceptance criteria (pass -> proceed to gradual ramp):
1) 99th pct latency for inference requests under threshold (as defined in checklist).
2) No sustained error rate > 1% (spike ok for < 60s if owner acknowledges).
3) KV cache hit-rate > 70% after priming loop.
4) No new egress blocks or NAT translation failures.

Rollback triggers (immediate abort and rollback to previous routing):
- Persistent 5xx > 2% for 2 minutes.
- Any data-plane ACL that blocks authenticated host egress.
- Observability pipeline failure (no ingestion > 5 minutes).

Owners / actions:
- Karthik (me): overall coordinator + rollback decision.
- Vivek: KV priming and cache warmup script owner.
- Laura: telemetry probes + paged alerts verification.
- Monica: ops bridge facilitator and runbook playback.
- DCS (Nina): facility-level config (switches, ACLs) and real-time ops on site.
- EdgeBank (John / ops@edgebank.com): read/write throttling and acceptance signoff.

Attachments: quartermile-smoke-checklist.pdf (checklist + pass criteria), network-routes.json (reference), and initial runbook links below.

Ask: Confirm owners and the 14:00 PST bridge. If you have any non-go/no-go constraints (e.g., EdgeBank wants lower write-rate) call them out now so we bake them into the smoke.

Karthik
Senior PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@dcs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.company>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.company>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.company>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.company>, John Pritchard <johnp@edgebank.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cutover safety: quarter-mile smoke & rollback scenarios for EdgeBank private deployment

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan. DCS confirms we will have on-site console access and baseline telemetry available for the 14:00 window. Two quick things from the facility-side scan this morning:
- There's a minor ACL that rejects ephemeral SNAT on one aggregation leaf; we will push a permissive rule at 13:40 and verify. (see attached: switch-config-snippet.txt)
- Our power monitoring saw a transient on Rack 6 last week; we validated redundancy and it is stable, but ops will keep a close watch during priming.

We will run the switch rule change in conservative mode and keep you posted. Confirming DCS on the bridge at 13:50.

—Nina
DataCenter Solutions — Field Ops
[attachment: switch-config-snippet.txt (text)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.company>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.company>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.company>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.company>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@dcs.com>, John Pritchard <johnp@edgebank.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cutover safety: quarter-mile smoke & rollback scenarios for EdgeBank private deployment

All —

I will own telemetry & alert verification. Plan:
- Deploy temporary extra probes for the smoke window (latency, p50/p95/p99, error-rate) at 13:45.
- Run the telemetry smoke-run script (see runbook link) at 14:02 immediately after route cut.
- I will acknowledge any paging escalations and correlate with app traces.

Link: https://docs.redwood.company/runbooks/telemetry-smoke (read-only)

Also tagging Monica to ensure the ops bridge has a playback of the rollback procedure at 13:55 so we can execute quickly if needed.

Laura
SRE Lead — Observability

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivev_kulkarni@redwood.company>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.company>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.company>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.company>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@dcs.com>, John Pritchard <johnp@edgebank.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cutover safety: quarter-mile smoke & rollback scenarios for EdgeBank private deployment

Karthik / team —

I will own the KV priming. Plan: run the priming loop 20 minutes prior to the bridge (13:40 start, ~20m run), then a short verify pass at 14:05 after route cut. Priming script notes: it performs 10k lightweight reads across hot prefixes, then ramps a slow write pattern to avoid cache churn.

If we see <70% cache hit-rate after priming, we either extend priming or hold the ramp. I will publish the priming metrics to the shared bucket and call out the hit rate.

Vivek
Lead Systems Engineer — Runtime

From: John Pritchard <johnp@edgebank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.company>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.company>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivev_kulkarni@redwood.company>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.company>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@dcs.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cutover safety: quarter-mile smoke & rollback scenarios for EdgeBank private deployment

Thanks — EdgeBank is good to proceed with the quarter-mile smoke at 14:00 PST. Couple of constraints from our side:
- Reduce write-rate during the smoke window to 30% of normal to limit risk to downstream ledgers.
- We require an audit snapshot (ingest log) at 14:30 for compliance.

I have attached an acceptance stub for our records. We will be monitoring on our side and will provide a short signoff after the 30-minute observation window.

John
Head of Platform Ops — EdgeBank
[attachment: edgebank-acceptance-sig.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.company>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.company>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.company>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.company>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@dcs.com>, John Pritchard <johnp@edgebank.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cutover safety: quarter-mile smoke & rollback scenarios for EdgeBank private deployment — run summary

Quick post-run summary (executive bullets):
- Smoke window executed: 14:05 — 14:25 PST (quarter-mile variant: 15m focused + 5–10m observation).
- Result: PASS (met acceptance criteria).
  - p99 latency within threshold across sample routes.
  - Error rate: brief spike to 1.4% at 14:09 for ~45s; traced to a transient egress SNAT misconfiguration. DCS pushed fix at 14:12 and error rate returned <0.3%.
  - KV cache: 78% hit-rate after priming (Vivek's priming loop completed as planned).
  - Observability: probe ingestion confirmed; netflow & traces present in shared bucket.

Attachments: deployment-log-20271109.txt, smoke-summary-20271109.csv.

Follow-ups / next steps:
- Full ramp schedule proposal: Tue 2027-11-16 AM (proposed) — will circulate a plan and new runbook checklist.
- Post-mortem item: add a pre-cutover SNAT validation step to the quartermile checklist to avoid the 14:09 transient. (Laura + DCS)
- Compliance: EdgeBank requested ingest audit snapshot at 14:30; Monica to push the snapshot to the compliance bucket and cc John.

Thank you everyone for quick responses and clean ops execution. Marking this thread as closed for the quarter-mile smoke; open a new thread for the full ramp.

Karthik
Senior PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
